SPC700 single-step fixtures provenance
Source: https://github.com/SingleStepTests/spc700/tree/main/v1
Cases: first 12 inputs from each of 00, 7a, 9a, af, c6, c7, d7, 8f, 4c, 5c,
       e8, 8d, cd, 2f, f0, d0, 3f, 6f, cf and 9e.
Additional cases: first 8 from each opcode 01 through 3e (hex), except 2f.
Additional cases: first 8 from every opcode 40 through 7f (hex), excluding
       4c, 5c, 6f and 7a, already present at 12 cases each.
Additional cases: first 8 from every opcode 80 through bf (hex), excluding
       8d, 8f, 9a, 9e and af, already present at 12 cases each.
Additional cases: first 8 from each opcode c0 through ff (hex), excluding
       c6, c7, cd, cf, d0, d7, e8 and f0, already present at 12 cases each.
Total: 2128 reference steps over all 256 distinct SPC700 opcode values.
Coverage validates individual instruction behavior, not commercial game audio.
The fixture contains reference CPU and bus data; no commercial ROMs or user data.
